|---|---|---|---|
| `snapshots/input/**` | Written for this project (synthetic fixtures). | — | Apache-2.0 (this repository) |
| `snapshots/output/**` | Generated by `SnapshotTests` (`SCIP_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1`). | — | Apache-2.0 (this repository) |
| `corpus/carddemo/app/{cbl,cpy,cpy-bms}` | [aws-samples/aws-mainframe-modernization-carddemo](https://github.com/aws-samples/aws-mainframe-modernization-carddemo) `app/cbl`, `app/cpy`, `app/cpy-bms`, copied verbatim. `LICENSE` and `NOTICE` are copied alongside as the licence requires. | `59cc6c2fd7ebd7ef7925cad552a01a4b8b6e4d5e` | Apache-2.0 |
| `corpus/nist85/*.CBL` | 22 programs of the NIST COBOL85 test suite (CCVS85), taken from the copy in [yutaro-sakamoto/tree-sitter-cobol](https://github.com/yutaro-sakamoto/tree-sitter-cobol) `test/cobol85/src`. Unchanged; the suite's copy library members (`K*`) are not part of that copy, so those COPY statements stay unresolved. | `550020ddf42ef9b718ad897868a9308d2afcda35` | Public domain (work of the U.S. Government, NIST); the hosting repository is MIT |

No GPL/LGPL/EPL material is included. Research-only sources (read, not copied) are listed in the project README.
